name: Remesh and Bake Holes
explanation_long: Remeshes to a lower face count, creates UVs and bakes surface details such as holes and material properties into (alpha) textures. This improves performance for real-time assets in games or XR.

exposed_options.name: Texture Baking Resolution
exposed_options.description: Steers the Resolution of the baked textures, default is 4096x4096 pixels.

exposed_options.name: Face Target
exposed_options.description: The target amount of faces (triangles), default is 50,000 triangles.

exposed_options.name: Remeshing Resolution
exposed_options.description: The initial (re)meshed resolution before any face target is applied. Higher resolutions (max 11), preserve more holes as geometry, lower resolutions (e.g. 6) close more holes in the actual mesh.
